items.title_en: France accuses Iran of cyber 'sabotage' in fridge attacks
items.title_zh: 法國指控伊朗在冰箱攻擊事件中進行網路「破壞」
items.summary_en: French officials say Iranian hackers attacked refrigeration systems. They changed the temperature at 700 stores. This caused a lot of food to go bad.
items.summary_zh: 法國官員表示，伊朗駭客攻擊了冷藏系統。他們更改了 700 家商店的溫度，導致大量食物變質。
items.why_important_en: This shows how cyberattacks can damage businesses and food supplies.
items.why_important_zh: 這顯示了網路攻擊如何對企業和食品供應造成損害。

vocab.definition_en: To say that someone has done something wrong or illegal.
vocab.sentence_en: Do not accuse your coworker without having clear evidence.
vocab.sentence_zh: 在沒有明確證據的情況下，不要指控你的同事。

vocab.definition_en: To become bad or not fit to eat.
vocab.sentence_en: The milk will spoil if you leave it out.
vocab.sentence_zh: 如果你把牛奶放在外面，它會變質。

items.title_en: Supreme Court says border wall construction can continue in west Texas
items.title_zh: 最高法院裁定德州西部的邊境牆建設可以繼續
items.summary_en: The US government asked the Supreme Court to allow wall construction. The court said the work can continue. This is happening while a legal case is ongoing.
items.summary_zh: 美國政府請求最高法院允許繼續建設邊境牆。法院表示工程可以繼續，目前相關法律訴訟仍在進行中。
items.why_important_en: It highlights the ongoing legal battles over border security policies.
items.why_important_zh: 這凸顯了關於邊境安全政策持續進行的法律鬥爭。

vocab.sentence_en: The construction of the new office building is finished.
vocab.sentence_zh: 新辦公大樓的建設已經完成了。

vocab.definition_en: To keep doing something without stopping.
vocab.sentence_en: Please continue with your presentation after the break.
vocab.sentence_zh: 休息後請繼續你的簡報。

items.title_en: What do we know about Nvidia CEO’s affair with a suspected Chinese spy?
items.title_zh: 我們對輝達執行長與疑似中國間諜的婚外情了解多少？
items.summary_en: Nvidia's CEO is in the news for a personal relationship. People are talking about his reputation. It is unclear how this will affect his work.
items.summary_zh: 輝達執行長因一段私人關係登上新聞。人們正在討論他的名聲，目前尚不清楚這會如何影響他的工作。
items.why_important_en: It shows how personal scandals can impact the public image of business leaders.
items.why_important_zh: 這顯示了個人醜聞如何影響企業領導人的公眾形象。

vocab.definition_en: The opinion that people have about someone or something.
vocab.sentence_en: Our company has a great reputation for quality service.
vocab.sentence_zh: 我們公司在優質服務方面享有盛譽。

vocab.definition_en: To think that someone is guilty of a crime.
vocab.sentence_en: I suspect that he is lying about his experience.
vocab.sentence_zh: 我懷疑他在工作經驗上撒謊。

items.title_en: British comedian Russell Brand sentenced to over 10 years for rape and sexual assault
items.title_zh: 英國喜劇演員羅素·布蘭德因強姦和性侵被判處 10 年以上徒刑
items.summary_en: A famous British comedian was found guilty of serious crimes. A court sentenced him to more than 10 years in prison. Six women brought the case against him.
items.summary_zh: 一位著名的英國喜劇演員被判犯有嚴重罪行。法院判處他 10 年以上監禁。此案由六名女性提出。
items.why_important_en: It marks a significant legal outcome in a high-profile celebrity sexual assault case.
items.why_important_zh: 這標誌著一起備受矚目的名人性侵案件取得了重大的法律結果。

vocab.definition_en: To officially say what punishment a person will receive.
vocab.sentence_en: The judge will sentence the thief tomorrow morning.
vocab.sentence_zh: 法官將在明天早上對小偷進行宣判。

vocab.definition_en: Responsible for doing something wrong or illegal.
vocab.sentence_en: The jury found the man guilty of the crime.
vocab.sentence_zh: 陪審團裁定該男子犯有此罪。

items.title_en: Qantas to cut 850 Australian jobs and outsource work to India under AI-driven overhaul
items.title_zh: 澳洲航空在 AI 驅動的改革下將裁減 850 個澳洲職位並將工作外包至印度
items.summary_en: Qantas is changing how it works using AI. They will cut 850 jobs in Australia. Some work will now be done in India.
items.summary_zh: 澳洲航空正在利用人工智慧改變其運作方式。他們將在澳洲裁減 850 個職位，部分工作將改由印度負責。
items.why_important_en: It demonstrates how AI is changing the job market and leading to outsourcing.
items.why_important_zh: 這展示了人工智慧如何改變就業市場並導致外包趨勢。

vocab.definition_en: To pay another company to do work for you.
vocab.sentence_en: We decided to outsource our customer service to save money.
vocab.sentence_zh: 我們決定將客戶服務外包以節省開支。

vocab.definition_en: A formal decision or promise between two or more people.
vocab.sentence_en: Both parties signed the agreement this afternoon.
vocab.sentence_zh: 雙方都在今天下午簽署了協議。
